name: Colour Mod
description: Per-channel brightness, contrast and gamma, then chroma. Order: contrast scales each channel around mid grey in display brightness (gamma 2.2) and leaves the colour strength alone, gamma raises each channel to a softened power of gamma, brightness adds to each channel, and chroma scales the colour away from the pixel's luminance.

params.label: Chroma
params.doc: Colour strength, from grey at 0 to the picture's own at 1.

params.label: Brightness
params.doc: Added to the red, green and blue channels.

params.label: Contrast
params.doc: Scales the red, green and blue channels around mid grey; 1 leaves them as they are.

params.label: Gamma
params.doc: Darkens the midtones of each channel above 1 and brightens them below 1; the strength is softened to the power gamma^0.6.
